The decisive mistake was made by HawaiiRealEstate_Expert at Step 2. It stated sale prices of $850,000 for 2072 Akaikai Loop and $950,000 for 2017 Komo Mai Drive without any lookup or cited source. The correct answer is 900000, so these figures were wrong. Every later agent, including Validation_Expert, only repeated the numbers and checked their formatting and ordering, so the wrong answer carried through to the end.
